player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone ci Blackjack kontar dealer.
Waxad def ngone moo gën a jege 21 ba noppi, ndeysaanu ko ba wàññi.
Ci tàmbali gi, tànn '[Hit]' ngir natt benn kart ngir yeneen walla '[Stand]' ngir wàññi.
J/Q/K = 10 poin; A = 11 walla 1, la gën a rafet.
